content.short: ITRocket runs validator infrastructure, public RPC endpoints and analytics across 30+ networks.
content.description: ITRocket operates validators across more than thirty networks including Monad, and publishes public RPC endpoints, snapshots and tooling alongside. Validator teams that maintain public infrastructure tend to become the practical default for developers in an ecosystem long before they are the largest by stake.
